common.demoNote: Demo mode: quality results and publish settings are kept in local mock storage only. No server or database is connected.
common.readOnlyBody: The quality officer cannot edit supplier or batch registration data (PDF §4).
common.insertOnlyBody: Quality results cannot be edited or deleted. A new measurement is added as a new record and every previous result stays in the history.
common.unitNote: Measurement units are a demo presentation. The system does not define MNS/ISO standards, acceptable lower/upper limits or a quality verdict.
common.latestOrderNote: The latest result is determined by entry time (created_at DESC, id DESC). The test date is used for display and reporting only.
common.noResultsHint: Adjust the search conditions and try again.
common.searchPlaceholder: Search by batch number, supplier or origin
common.notFoundHint: The number may be incorrect or the record may not exist.
common.storageError: Could not save. Please try again.
common.invalidTest: The entered value does not meet the requirements.

dashboard.title: Quality work dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Find a batch, enter laboratory results manually, compare with the previous result and choose the fields published on the QR page.
dashboard.statBatchesHint: Registered batches visible to the quality officer.
dashboard.statTestsHint: Total rows kept in the insert-only history.
dashboard.statPublishedHint: Batches whose QR page is in the published state.
dashboard.workflowHint: The eight-step quality officer workflow from the PDF.
dashboard.stepSearchHint: Search by batch number, supplier or origin.
dashboard.stepEnterHint: Enter fineness, yield, admixture, test date and lab information manually.
dashboard.stepValidateHint: Checks required fields, numeric values, mathematical bounds and a non-future test date.
dashboard.stepSaveHint: The result is appended to the insert-only history and shown as the latest result with a success message.
dashboard.stepCompareHint: Compare the latest result with the previous result.
dashboard.stepPublishHint: Choose which permitted fields appear on the QR page.
dashboard.stepPreviewHint: Check that only the selected whitelist fields appear.
dashboard.recentHint: Latest quality records ordered by entry time.
dashboard.recentEmptyHint: Find a batch and enter the first test result.
dashboard.awaitingHint: The most recently registered batches without a result.
dashboard.awaitingEmptyHint: No batches are currently awaiting testing.

search.title: Find batch
search.subtitle: Search registered batches by number, supplier, origin, quality state and QR state. Registration data cannot be edited.
search.tableHint: Select the batch number to open the read-only details.

detail.subtitle: Read-only view of the batch registration data, quality result history and QR publish state.
detail.infoHint: This section was registered by the registration clerk — the quality officer cannot change it.
detail.qualityEmptyHint: The latest result will appear here after the laboratory result is entered manually.
detail.previousHint: Read-only history that can never be edited. The three most recent records.
detail.qrMissingHint: The registration clerk generates the QR code. The public page is unavailable while no QR exists.

test.title: Enter a test result
test.subtitle: Enter the laboratory result manually. The system does not perform laboratory testing and has no direct laboratory integration.
test.sectionResultHint: All fields are required. Values are checked against mathematical bounds only.
test.cleanYieldHint: Percentage between 0 and 100. This is a mathematical bound, not a quality standard.
test.admixtureHint: Percentage between 0 and 100. This is a mathematical bound, not a quality standard.
test.testedOnHint: A future date is not allowed.
test.labResultHint: Enter the laboratory protocol, conclusion or explanation as free text.
test.labPlaceholder: Example: Demo laboratory protocol No. L-2605-018; the sample measurement result was recorded.
test.errorFineness: Enter fineness as a number greater than 0.
test.errorFutureDate: The test date cannot be in the future.
test.errorStorage: Could not save the result. Please try again.
test.errorInvalid: The entered value does not meet the requirements.
test.successBody: A new quality result was added to the history. It cannot be edited or deleted — the next measurement is entered as a new result.
test.previousHint: After the new result is saved it becomes the latest result.
test.noPrevious: No previous result for this batch. You are entering the first result.
test.newBecomesLatest: After saving, the new result becomes the latest result.
test.unitNote: Units are a demo presentation; no standards or limits are defined.

history.title: Quality result history
history.subtitle: Every entered laboratory result, ordered by entry time. Previous results are never removed.
history.scopedSubtitle: Every quality result entered for this batch. The latest result is determined by entry time.
history.searchPlaceholder: Search by batch number or lab result information
history.emptyHint: Find a batch and enter a laboratory result.
history.scopedEmptyHint: The history appears here after the first result is entered.

compare.title: Compare with the previous result
compare.subtitle: Compares the two latest results of one batch. This is a numeric difference only, not a quality verdict.
compare.deltaHint: Difference = latest − previous. A positive or negative value is not a quality assessment.
compare.orderNote: The latest result is determined by entry time (created_at DESC, id DESC). The test date is not the ordering key.
compare.noStandardNote: The system does not define MNS/ISO standards, acceptable limits or a quality verdict. The comparison only shows the difference between recorded numbers.
compare.noTestsHint: Comparison becomes available after at least two results are entered for this batch.
compare.oneTestHint: Add the next measurement as a new record to compare it with the previous result.

publish.indexSubtitle: Choose the fields published on each batch's QR page. Only fields from the PDF §9.1 whitelist are available.
publish.title: Choose QR publish fields
publish.subtitle: Choose from the permitted fields. The batch number is always published; personal data, internal notes and previous history can never be published.
publish.statusHint: When published, only the selected fields appear on the QR page.
publish.statusHiddenHint: In the hidden state the QR page is not publicly accessible.
publish.statusPublishedHint: In the published state the selected fields appear on the QR page.
publish.fieldsHint: Only the latest quality result is published; the previous result history is never published.
publish.savedHint: The selected fields will appear on the QR page. Check the public preview.
publish.noTestHint: Enter the laboratory result before publishing quality metrics.
publish.qrMissingHint: The registration clerk generates the QR code. Without a QR code the public page stays unavailable even after saving.
publish.whitelistNote: PDF §9.1: batch number, aimag/soum, supply weight (when approved), livestock count (when public consent exists), latest quality result (fineness, clean yield, admixture, test date) and public verification status only.
publish.latestHint: Selected quality fields take their values from this result.

fieldHints.supplyAmount: The approved amount registered for the batch.
fieldHints.livestockCount: Only when public disclosure is permitted.
fieldHints.testedOn: Test date of the latest result only.
fieldHints.verificationStatus: Public verification state of the QR code.

publish.errorStorage: Could not save the configuration. Please try again.
publish.searchPlaceholder: Search by batch number or supplier
publish.noResultsHint: Adjust the search conditions and try again.

preview.title: Public QR page preview
preview.subtitle: Only selected whitelist fields appear. This is a preview; the QR token is never rendered here.
preview.draftHiddenHint: The configuration is in the hidden state. The QR page becomes public after the published state is saved.
preview.publishedHint: The QR page is publicly accessible.
preview.noOptionalFields: Only the batch number is published. No optional fields are selected.
preview.excludedHint: The following information never appears on the QR page (PDF §9.1).
preview.qrMissingHint: After the registration clerk generates the QR code, this page becomes reachable through it.
preview.footerNote: This page shows only the selected whitelist fields. Supplier personal data, internal notes and previous result history are never published.
